messages.subject: Anyone want to maintain the enigma pkg ?
messages.subject_clean: Anyone want to maintain the enigma pkg ?
messages.body_plain:
HI all,

Does anyone want to take over maintainance of the enigma package? I asked for the enigma pkg (https://github.com/ropengov/enigma) to be archived on CRAN because I am no longer interested in maintaining it. They made a new API maybe 6 months or  1 year ago, and I just haven't had time to update the package to work with it, and plus I haven't seen much interest in it.  If no interest here I'll ping to see if anyone on twitter is interested.

Best, Scott
